Ban the sale of small animal enclosures that do not meet specified standards, I would like new legislation to prevent the sale of unsuitable animal enclosures which are currently available to pet owners.
The Government should set minimum enclosure sizes for small animals in domestic settings, and ban the sale of enclosures that do not meet these standards.
, I volunteer for a small animal rescue and have seen tragic cases of small animals being kept in unsuitable conditions. We need the Government to take action to ban the sale of small animal enclosures that do not meet the minimum enclosure sizes set by Government.

Give fathers a right to be added to birth certificates if proven by a DNA test, Currently fathers only hold parental responsibility if they are married to the mother or named on the birth certificate. I would like Government to give fathers the right, if a DNA test has been completed and there are no welfare reasons, to be added to the birth certificate without a court case., The baby is genetically 50/50, and we believe it should not be up to the mother to agree whether a father is added to the birth certificate.
 
If a mother doesn't agree to reregister a birth certificate, a father needs to get a Declaration of Parentage from the courts, which can be time consuming and costly. We want fathers to have the right to be added to the birth certificate without a court case, if a DNA test has been completed and there are no welfare reasons.

Amend the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 by including more dog breeds to be banned, Amend current list of banned dog breeds (currently 4) by adding the following breeds: American Bully - all kinds (XL, Extreme, Pocket, Standard, Classic), Staffordshire Bull Terrier, American Staffordshire Terrier, American Pit Bull Terrier, Bull Terrier (incl. Miniature)., There have been too many dog attacks, including those resulting in the death of a person, involving some of these breeds.
 
We believe banning breeding and owning dogs of these breeds would help improve public safety.

Make DNA paternity testing mandatory prior to registration on birth certificate, I would like the Government to make a law that states before being registered on a birth certificate there should be DNA paternity testing to make sure that the child is theirs., There are too many cases where fathers have found out that a child isn’t theirs after long periods of time. Mandatory DNA paternity testing should prevent this.

Create a register of animal abusers, with mandatory checks by breeders/shops/etc, We want the Government to create a register of people who are found guilty of harming or neglecting animals., Anyone selling or giving away an animal should be required to check this register, and prevented from selling or giving an animal to a registered abuser.
 
Too many animals are experiencing cruelty. A new register, and mandatory checks before an animal can be given to an owner, could help prevent this.

Ban the ownership of dogs with cropped ears born after April 2023, We want the UK Government to ban the ownership in England of dogs with cropped ears, for any dogs born in the UK after April 2023., Ear cropping is barbaric and un-necessary. It is purely cosmetic and has no place in caring dog ownership. Ear cropping is often  a preferred cosmetic procedure for people wanting 'designer' dogs and has no place in responsible dog ownership. Banning ownership of dogs with cropped ears should complement the existing ban on this procedure, and any ban on imports of dogs with cropped ears. Owners of dogs with cropped ears would be subject to investigation and prosecution.

Make dog attacks on cats a specific criminal offence, Where a cat is attacked or killed by a dog, often no action is taken. We want the Government to make dog attacks on cats a specific offence under the Dangerous Dogs Act, so it is taken seriously when reported. All pets deserve to be protected. Irresponsible dog owners should be punished., Our cat was attacked and killed death in our own front garden by a dog that was off leash and not under the command of the owner. Our cat suffered multiple fractures and paralysis and died in agony. Current legislation does not adequately cover irresponsible dog owners who allow this to happen.

Allow single parents to change a child's name without the other parent's consent, To allow single parents to change their child’s surname without the other parent's permission, without having to go through the court procedure, even if the other parent is listed on the birth certificate. This is particularly important especially where domestic violence and abuse has occurred.,

Tougher sentences for vehicle theft including aggravated burglary, Car crime is one of the most common crimes in the UK and a significant proportion is linked to organised crime. Manufacturers are making it easier for vehicle theft through keyless entry. The Government needs to deter this by increasing the sentences for those caught or involved in car crime., The DVLA quoted that 58,082 vehicles were stolen in 2022, with only 28% being recovered. The Government need to sanction tougher sentences to deter this. The effect this has on the victim can be horrific and yet nothing seems to be done about it. Car theft also affects the general population when insurance renewals come around in higher premiums.

Require dog breeders to submit DNA samples of all dogs for a central database., Make submission of canine DNA samples compulsory. These should be on a central database, linked to microchip and ancestral data. This would allow owners to access their dog’s ancestry information, including information about dogs that have been destroyed or seized under the Dangerous Dogs Act., We believe that lack of adequate oversight of dog breeding has led to an increase in the number of dogs of unmanageable breeds, abandoned pets, and a rise in dog attacks - and deaths.
 
Breeders must be held accountable.
 
It’s about time the Government stepped up and did something proactive to ensure new dog owners have information about their dog, and its ancestry.
 
We believe this could help reduce the rise in canine crime and dog theft.

Reform the Honours System and make it independent of Government, We want the Honours System to be reformed so honours are granted only to those who perform acts of exceptional bravery or humanitarianism and those in the voluntary sector who do exceptional work for the community, charity or the environment. Honours should be granted independent of the Government., We believe the current system results in a disproportionate number of honours going to politicians, public servants and public figures who have performed only what was expected of them in their employment or positions. Indeed, some honours appear to reward mediocracy or failure and there have been political nominations of questionable virtue.

We want the government to prove there is no fraud in all the acts of parliament., We want the government to prove there is no fraud in all of the acts that the parliament has enacted, past, present and future., Parliament is a public body that works for the public, they have a duty and an obligation to provide crystal clear legislation that contains no fraud.
Make all dogs no matter what breed muzzled in public, Pass law to make it illegal to have a dog unmuzzled in public, The recent dog attacks and deaths need to stop

Require bars/clubs have spiking test kits and staff trained on spiking incidents, We want the Government to require clubs/pubs to have spiking test to help work out if a person has been spiked. Also there should be requirements for staff to be trained to identify potential spikers and victims of spiking, and to provide first aid to victims., I have been spiked on two occasions, once on the 1st April 2022 and the 2nd time was on the 25th February 2023. Nothing was done about it so now I feel like I need to make a change. No one should be going out and fear that they could potentially be spiked. I’m lucky that I wasn’t seriously hurt but someone might get seriously hurt soon!

Require dogs in public places to be on a lead at all times, People need to feel safe going for a walk with their dogs. There are too many irresponsible dog owners out there who have no recall, no training experience for themselves or their dogs. Given this, we believe dogs should be required to be on a lead whenever they are in a public place., Dogs can be volatile regardless of how friendly they can be, and should be in controlled by owners at all times. There are too many dog deaths and injuries due to irresponsible owners. The Government should make it law that people should always have their dogs on leads in public.

Scrap the honours system and all previously granted honours, We want the Government to abolish the current honours system, including all previously granted honours. We believe this system is sycophantic and nepotistic., As there have been previous allegations of cronyism, sycophancy and cash for honours and now allegations of nepotism, we believe it is time to scrap the honours system. There is a need to restore public confidence in democratic institutions, and we think this cannot be done when the honours system lends itself to charges of corruption.

Issue birth certificates for all babies born still from 10 weeks gestation., I would like the law changed so all babies born still at 10 weeks and over get a birth certificate. In 2020 I gave birth to a baby girl at 16 weeks to then be told she would never be registered as a person as she was born under 24 weeks. No parent who is grieving their loss needs to hear this., There are so many babies being born asleep under 24 weeks that aren't being registered. The truth is these babies are still human beings and deserve to be recognised properly. Its heartbreaking hearing no birth certificate can be given when your heart is breaking. When I gave birth there were 6 other mums who gave birth on the same day. Surely now in this day and age the law has to change. 24 weeks just isn't right and lots of parents want certificates to help mourn the loss of their babies.

Regulate service charges by housing associations and management companies., Safeguard leaseholders from unjustified and excessive service charges by housing associations and block management companies. Leaseholders in many developments have seen annual increases of 30% or more this year alone, making their living situation unaffordable. Service charges are unregulated., Additionally, stop housing associations and management companies from being able to ask for past adjustment charges that are out of time.

Hold non paying parents accountable for neglect.

Ensure payments are made CSA, The CSA do not seem to follow their own rules in regards to child maintenance.

In America non paying parents are held accountable for neglect and often lose their parental rights!

I am owed over £7000 in child maintenance it’s not me who loses out it’s my child!, We are in a cost of living crisis. For years I have fought for child maintenance to the point it made me poorly.

There are millions of pounds not being paid/outstanding in areas. A single parent can be held accountable if they can’t feed their child yet the other non involved parent is not held accountable. 

Things need to change.

Prohibit the killing of domestic pets in a pandemic or domestic emergency, Introduce legislation to prohibit domestic pets from being killed in any event or national emergency, pandemic, outbreak or otherwise. Lord Bethell recently revealed the Government had considered whether it might have to ask people to exterminate pet cats due to covid-19., Domestic pets are extremely loving and comforting companion animals that helped many owners to overcome a great deal of personal trauma linked to the pandemic, such as loneliness, the loss of family and friends and worsening health issues. We believe it would be immoral for a single domestic pet to be killed, whatever the circumstances. We now need legislation to prevent this possibility of domestic pets being killed due to a national emergency.

Stop the BBC licence fee, Debate in Parliament the merits of the BBC licence fee with the aim of curtailing it, The BBC have handled the Lineker issue appallingly resulting in their status being downgraded. Consequently the channels should no longer receive state funding via a subscription service; the licence fee is outdated to say the least!

Reverse the short-sighted decision to axe the BBC Singers, Make the BBC reconsider the decision to withdraw all funding from the BBC Singers, The BBC Singers are unique amongst choirs in a unique choral tradition, performing new music that would never be written without the prospect of a performance by them, in addition to which they support music education in schools, and composers at college and university.

Commit to providing all Government services by offline channels, We want the Government to commit to making offline channels available for all Government services, such as counter terrorism checks and tax services. We are concerned that making services like this online only is inconsistent with rights to privacy., We should be able to choose how to provide personal data that is necessary to access many public services, and some people do not wish to provide this online.
 
There are increasing moves to make Government services digital only. We want offline channels to be available for all Government services.

Add Multiple Sclerosis to the medical exemption list, To obtain a medical exemption certificate and get free NHS prescriptions, a condition needs to be on the medical exemption list. , People with MS suffer every day with struggles in their lives. As a country, we are making them pay for an illness they never asked for. This needs to stop. People with MS should be looked after, not forgotten about.

Ban leaseholders from having no pets clauses, The Government should recognise that leaseholders are putting restrictions on purchasers and tenants to say that they can’t own pets, such as a companion dog. Some people are choosing to remain homeless rather than be parted from their beloved companion.
, I am presently purchasing a ground floor flat in what was previously a local authority block. It is now under the management of a housing association who are the leaseholders of the block. My visitors will be allowed to bring their dogs with them, despite my dog being prohibited from living with me.

Let airlines allow pets in the airplane’s cabin to and from the UK, Change the rules of animal travel so they can travel with their owners (with all the documentation and vaccines in order) inside airplanes instead of in the hold with luggage.
It is allowed in many other countries around the world, including in the EU, South America, and the USA., Many pets are seen as an extension of the family. Many airlines allow pets up to 9kg to travel to most countries inside the airplane cabin, in their pet carrier, instead of in the cargo hold. However, they are not allowed on most airplanes coming to the UK, regardless of their size.

This not only distresses the pets and owners, it also risks their health and safety, having several cases of injured, sick, or even dead pets because of the conditions of the flight, as they are treated as luggage.

Urgent review into the protection of unborn children in domestic violence cases, Too many unborn babies are killed or harmed by domestic violence. Current laws protecting the mother don't always provide immediate protection for the unborn child. Child destruction laws only apply where there's proof of intent to harm the baby and even then only if they are at least 28 weeks old. , The Government should commission an urgent review to improve the protections of all unborn children in domestic violence cases, looking at how more immediate protections can be put in place when there is an unborn child, and updating child destruction laws to include all unborn children, regardless of age and remove the burden of proving an attempt to harm the baby to knowledge of a pregnancy when attacking the mother.

Establish a Register of Protected works of Literature, We believe English language is our greatest cultural contribution to the world., We therefore call on Government to establish a Register of Protected Literature, like the Listing system for protected buildings, which cannot be published in a rewritten form, for example, in the name of 'sensitivity'.
 
In an era when established literary treasures such as the works of Roald Dahl and PG Wodehouse are being republished with changes to the text, to remove 'problematic' language, we call upon Government to follow in the tradition of protecting at risk listed structures, and establish a Register of Protected Literature.
 
Inclusion in this list should be decided by an independent non-political commission, and inclusion on the list should include appropriately and clearly defined legally enforceable protections.

Require organisations providing Cryptocurrency services to hold insurance, Require cryptocurrency exchanges to hold insurance to cover victims of fraud and theft against massive financial losses through no fault of their own, Victims of fraud and identity theft where money is transferred via Cryptocurrency often find they are unable to recover any lost funds due to the irreversible nature of the transactions

Often people who fall short of these circumstances are older and/or retired and could lose their life savings to criminals

I would like the government to put into legislation a requirement for Cryptocurrency Exchanges to hold insurance cover to protect victims of these scams

Ban chick hatching projects in schools, Some schools have chick hatching projects, promoted by some companies. A mother hen turns eggs 30 times a day to ensure the chicks don’t get stuck to the shell, which can result in injury or death. Teachers cannot provide this care, and eggs/chicks may be left unattended over evenings/weekends., Once a chick hatching scheme is over, chicks will either be returned to the company where their fate is uncertain, or they may be rehomed by someone in school. However the cockerels are usually unwanted.  

This is a cost to schools, the eggs/chicks are not cared for properly and it results inevitably with unwanted cockerels being born and culled.  Please ban this practice in schools on animal welfare grounds- there are more humane ways of teaching children about chicken lifecycles.

Make dogs attacking other pets a specific criminal offence, We want people to be held accountable for dogs that attack other pets. At the moment a dog attacking another pet isn't an offence unless it's deemed to be out of control. We want this to be made a specific offence, like worrying livestock., It has been reported that dog on dog attacks are on the increase, and we are concerned that this has been exacerbated by a lack of knowledge of owners about the heritage of their dogs and needs for training.
 
People’s pets are being hurt or killed and we believe the Government needs to change the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 in order to make dogs attacking other pets a specific offence. If a dog attacked a flock of sheep or chickens the owner would be guilty of an offence and the dog could be put down, but if a dog attacks and kills a pet, and isn't judged to be out of control this wouldn't be an offence. We believe this is not fair and needs to be changed

Require domestic cats be kept indoors or in a cat-proof garden, I am worried about cats killing innocent birds and other wildlife and fouling in other people's gardens, especially as this is a disease risk, particularly to young children and pregnant women. We have had cats killing the baby birds from our nest boxes., In the US most cats are kept indoors, and we don't see any reason why they can't live happy lives indoors in the UK.

Ban garden smoke houses, Garden smoke houses produce a massive amount of smoke, We are trying as a country to reduce are carbon footprint, garden smoke houses pollute the environment. I personally have to close all my windows and window vents when neighbours set their smoker off which lasts approximately 7 hours

Social services and bodycams, So many children are ending up in the care system because of some really bad social workers. Bodycams would stop this, I would like government to do this to help more families stay together.  Lots of parents in our country have had their children took because of a certain few bad social workers and its happing a lot in the UK. Bodycam needs to be worn.

Require DBS checks for pet and house sitters, Currently, it is not mandatory in the UK for pet/house sitters to have a DBS check undertaken., I recently lost my pet cat as a result of cruelty subjected to him by a sitter whom I invited to my home via a house sitters website. The paid platform did not take responsibility for their actions and confirmed that they do not undertake DBS check on the sitters listed on their website.

Remove breed specific legislation. Consider alternative methods for dog control., Remove breed specific provisions in the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991. We believe this legislation is unfair, not fit for purpose and has not had the desired results of limiting dog bites. It has had the result of family pets being destroyed, causing devastation to many families., I believe that the current legislation is causing more harm than good. I have seen horrific accounts of how this legislation is being enforced.
 
I believe that it is primarily the rearing of a dog that determines the behaviour and not the breed. Dogs shouldn't be destroyed because of their breed.

Require jet ski owners and businesses to obtain licenses, Require jet ski owners and businesses to have licenses to operate a jet ski in public bodies of water and the sea., Jet skis are dangerous and we believe there are too many irresponsible owners.

Allow small dogs/cats to fly in cabin when entering the UK on commercial planes., Current law requires dogs/cats to travel as ‘cargo’ (under the plane) when entering the UK. We ask the government to change the law so that dogs & cats can travel in-cabin and aren’t required to be manifest cargo. 
The USA, EU & other nations allow in cabin travel. Lets bring our pets home in cabin, This is an out-dated law that provides no benefit to the pet or its welfare. Besides this, people consider their pets to truly be family or companions. There are times when we need to take our pets abroad and putting them in the luggage causes serious anxiety to the animal.
The pick-up point for pets is often far from the terminal meaning the pet is left for hours longer than needed. 
The pick-up point can close early holding your pet overnight. 
Airlines can loose the pet as its luggage.

Change the police's no-pursuit policy on stolen/illegal  motorbikes, I want the government to end the no-pursuit policy on stolen motorbikes and drivers who are not wearing helmets which are often linked to drug running  London can use tactics but no other force can., Grow a backbone and allow the police forces everywhere to pursue these. People who are just going by their daily lives are getting injured when they're not even being pursued so by letting the police sit back and do nothing is not really helping so what if a suspect gets a broken arm they did the crime they pay for it simple then they might learn not to do it again. Also, make it where police can't be sued for this.

Ban brand deals and sponsorships for child influencers, In order to safeguard children, and protect children from being exploited by their parents on social media for monetary gain. The Government needs to ban brand deals and sponsorships for child influencers., Banning brand deals and sponsorships for child influences will demotivate parents for turning their children into influencers, as a big motivation is the large amount of money that brands will pay for advertising.

Ban the use of strimmers in spring during hedgehog breeding season, Hedgehogs are in decline and every year many hedgehogs are seriously injured or killed by strimmers and mowers. We want the Government to ban the use of strimmers during the hedgehog breeding season. This should apply to domestic gardens, businesses and council workmen clearing public land., Please put a ban on garden strimmer use, to be run alongside the ban on cutting agricultural hedges through the bird nesting season, as the hedgehog breeding/nesting season takes place around the same time. It could help to save many hedgehogs being killed. The ban should apply to domestic gardens, businesses, and also council workmen clearing hedgerows and wasteland as well.

Change legal definition of stillborn to include all delivered babies, We want the Government to change the legal definition of stillborn to include all delivered babies, so that parent's whose child who is stillborn under 24 weeks can register this, and receive support through the Children’s Funeral Fund for England., I recently lost my daughter at 22 weeks. I had to give birth to her and I am currently planning her funeral, but I get no help as she wasn't 24 weeks old. I think this is disgusting.
 
It is traumatising enough for a parent to lose a child and have to give birth to them, but then to be told you can't register the death of your baby because your baby wasn’t 24 weeks can add to a parent's distress.
 
We want the Government to change the legal definition of stillborn to include all delivered babies, so they are recognised in law.

Make Paid Pet Bereavement Leave Compulsory in the Workplace, When losing a pet there should be up to 5 days paid compassionate leave in the workplace. This should only be provided if there is proof from a vet of the loss of a pet and the cause of death. For some people their pets are all they have in life., Many people see animals as just as important as humans, therefore their loss should be acknowledged and people given time to grieve.
 
Please Note, pet bereavement leave should only be agreed if there is proof from a vet of the loss of a pet and the cause of death. In no circumstances should this law allow people who cause harm against an animals to receive bereavement leave.

Make it law that all high schools have fully-trained mental health staff present, Parliament should make a law that means it is mandatory that High-Schools in England have to have a properly trained mental-health professional in the premise 24/7 for students years 7-11, High-School is such a stressful time for not only new years, but all years. It is a big change and with the heinous rise in mental health cases for teenagers, schools should have a fully-trained and able member of staff to not only listen to student mental health, but help them. With a 24/7 member of staff present in schools, fully-trained and passionate about others wellbeing and saftey this could be a great thing for High-Schools being affected by a mass increase in bad mental-health.

Increase restrictions on use of drones under 250g in weight, Change the regulations pertaining to drone and model aircraft operation in order to prevent drones under 250g in weight from being allowed to fly over, around, viewing or filming private property without prior permission from the property's owner and residents., People's privacy is being invaded by the flying over and around their homes of small, cheap and widely available drones fitted with video cameras. The current regulations prohibit larger drones from doing this but allow sub-250g drones to do so. The size and weight of a drone has little bearing on its ability to carry high-definition video equipment and the regulations should also prohibit sub-250g drones from being able to film people in and on their own private property without consent.

Make pet abduction a specific criminal offence, Pets are family. Their abduction a traumatic experience. Despite this, stolen pets are regarded as personal property, with sentences dependent on monetary value. The Government should recognise the emotional & welfare impacts this crime has on people & pets by introducing a 'pet abduction' offence., Pet Theft Reform has been campaigning to make pet theft a specific offence with access to appropriate custodial sentences since 2018. Four petitions in four years - each triggered parliamentary debates, with a total of 684,970 signatures.

Following a recommendation from the Pet Theft Taskforce, the Government added pet abduction ("taking of pets") to the Animal Welfare (Kept Animals) Bill in November 2021. 

The Government dropped the Kept Animals Bill in May 2023.

Introduce compulsory Third Party insurance to cover dogs., To introduce a compulsory third party insurance requirement for dog owners to cover injury or property damage caused by their dogs, Too many people are being attacked by dogs and in some cases actually killed. A third party insurance requirement will allow Insurance Companies to set premiums according to breeds and dog attack history. The same way motor insurance is higher for bad drivers.

Allow trans and nonbinary people to legally change their date of birth, When a person is trans, their date of birth is often a reminder of their deadname and dead identity, by allowing a legal change of date of birth, it gives trans people the freedom to choose not only their date of birth and when it is celebrated, but the freedom to be accepted and comfortable,

Allow lay people to undertake artificial insemination of dogs, Currently only registered veterinarians are legally allowed to undertake artificial insemination of dogs. We want the Government to allow lay people to undertake this procedure, having completed a Government-sanctioned course and been certified., Thousands of breeders will now have to rely on vets to perform this service. We believe this is not ideal as some vets are not supportive of dog breeding and will not perform the procedure. Also vets are not always available to undertake this procedure.
 
Some breeders want to be able to perform this procedure themselves, so they don't have to put their livelihood in the hands of another person. We ask that the Government creates a routes for lay people to be trained and certified to undertake this procedure.
Scrap The BBC license fee and disband the BBC, Disband the BBC and scrap the license fee, Enough is Enough we the public will no longer fund the BBC

End ban on having pit bull terriers as pets
, Pit bulls are amazing dogs and it's wrong that they are banned in the UK. There are no dangerous dogs, just owners. We want the ban to be lifted in the UK, These dogs are so loving, but get a bad name because of their owners. They are not dangerous, they are very loving and deserve a chance.
Ban the use of catapults, The Government should ban the use of catapults to help prevent hurting people and animals. We shouldn't live in fear of our cats etc. being hurt by these weapons.,

Create a pet task force to seek to reduce number of pets being put to sleep, We want the Government to form a pet task force to look at ways of reducing the number of pets being put to sleep. The task force should look at licensing arrangements for breeders, online sales and enforcement, including the adequacy of sentences for animal cruelty and breeding without a licence., It has been estimated that in the year to February 2022 around 3.4 million households gave up a pet. Many registered rescue charities in England are full, resulting in pets being put to sleep by owners and councils while new licences to breed are still being issued. Staff working in shelters are under immense strain, which can affect their mental health.

Prevent resignation honours from former Prime Ministers
 
, We want the Government to block nominations for resignations honours from former Prime Ministers.
 
, It might also be helpful for the Government to publicise this change.
 
In recent years, Prime Ministers have submitted Resignation Honours lists. These lists have been submitted irrespective of the performance of the Prime Minister, and the impact they have had on the British people.

Make XL Bully a banned dog breed in the Dangerous Dogs Act, These dogs have been at the centre of numerous attacks of varying severity. I believe there is a need for these dogs to be placed on the list of banned dogs in the Dangerous Dogs Act, so it is illegal to sell, own or breed these dogs., One campaign group has said it has identified 143 reported dog attacks involving XL Bully dogs in 2023 - over 20% of all dog attacks it has identified.

Exempt rare cars over 30 years old from MOT and vehicle tax, We want the Government to extend MOT and vehicle tax exemptions for historic cars that were registered over 40 years ago to cars that are over 30 years old and few in number., Owners of cars that are over 30 years old should be able to apply for MOT and vehicle tax exemptions if there are few in number of the car left on the UK roads. This would reduce the cost of keeping these cars, and should help prevent them from being scrapped. DVLA data can be used to determine whether a car is rare enough to be eligible under this scheme.

Introduce new requirements for cat breeders, Everyone who wants to breed cats should be required to get a licence and meet the relevant licence conditions. There should also be an online platform where cat breeders are registered, and details of cats bred and sold held. If a person breeds cats illegally they should face a fine or jail., The new online platform should include the name, address, and contact information of breeders, and their identity should be verified at the point of registration.

The platform should also include details of the cats they are breeding, pictures of the cats, microchip information, numbers, vaccination cards, and details or spaying or neutering. The breeder should have to update profile of cats when they are sold.

Require anyone who breeds dogs to have a licence, Change in the law to require anyone who breeds dogs to obtain a licence first. There are too many poor dogs being rehomed and abandoned, in part due to too many unlicensed breeders who don't care about the dogs they breed., We need to change the law to help with this heart-breaking situation

Add hedgehogs to Schedule 5 Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, I have supported and rescued hedgehogs in my Norfolk garden for 11 years. There are too many cases of hedgehogs being killed or injured, including intentionally. Adding hedgehogs to Schedule 5 would give a species in serious decline additional legal protection, Hedgehogs are listed as vulnerable in Natural England's IUCN-compliant red list. They are subject to intentional and reckless killing and injury as well as damage and disturbance to their habitat. The RSPCA found that incidents of abuse, including beating, improper killing, mutilation, and neglect increased from 2011-15 and 2016-20.
 
Adding hedgehogs to Schedule 5 Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 would provide additional legal protection for an iconic species in serious decline.

Require people to complete an online course on animal care to buy a pet, The Government should create online courses with the information required for proper care for each pet species available in England. Courses should finish with a test you would need to pass to produce a certificate. Breeders and pet shops should require certificates from potential pet owners., Under the Animal Welfare Act of 2006, owners have a duty of care to their animals and must meet their needs. However, many animals still suffer due to their owners' errors, often stemming from a lack of accessible, evidence-based information. Government courses would increase the accessibility of this information and prevent animal suffering. The UK already has some of the most comprehensive animal protection laws in the world. Let's properly support all pet owners in upholding them!

Make neutering compulsory for pet cats and dogs, The Government should consult with professional bodies and rescues to decide when animals should be neutered, then introduce compulsory neutering, with fines for owners whose pets have a litter when they should have been neutered. Give vets the responsibility to report offenders., Working animals and registered breeders etc would fall outside the scope of this legislation.

Many rescues are overwhelmed at the moment. This is partly due to the cost of living crisis. There are boxes of kittens and puppies that are being abandoned. Adoptions have also slowed due to the cost of pet ownership.

This means many rescues are almost always full with a waiting list, and often unable to help in cases such as when a pet is lost or whose owner has passed away.

Introduce mandatory neutering of pet cats, In April Spain introduced compulsory sterilisation of cats by six months of age, unless they are registered as breeding animals. We are calling on the Government to tackle the crisis of homeless cats, by making neutering of cats mandatory by six months of age, except of licensed breeding cats., We have a major crisis with homeless cats. Many rescues are full and cannot help all stray cats. This is because owners are not getting cats neutered allowing them to multiply.
 
The breeding is totally out of control, kittens are being born outside, with some being eaten by other wildlife or creating feral colonies. Come the winter, many may die of hypothermia.
 
Future breeding of cats must be controlled and licensed accordingly.

Allow two mothers to be listed on a child's birth certificate, Section 33(1) of Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 2008 prevents two mothers being allowed to be listed on the birth certificate of a child. We would like for this to be amended to allow two mothers for same sex families rather than 'mother' and 'parent'., We undertook shared motherhood IVF in order to fulfil our desire to be equal mothers. After a difficult process to create a family we were blessed with our daughter who we are both mother to.
 
On registering the birth we were equally disappointed to learn that the law does not recognise two mothers. Law states - no other woman is to be treated as the mother of the child. Allowing only the 'natural mother' to be recognised. The other is listed as 'parent' rather than 'mother' creating inequality

Make it compulsory for schools to first aid train all staff, This could save lives in emergency situations, when immediate action is needed. Require dose counters on SABA metered dose inhalers (MDIs), In the interest of public health and safety I would like the Government to make it a legal requirement that pharmaceutical companies must provide dose counters for their short acting beta 2 agonist (SABA) such as Salamol metered-dose inhalers (MDIs)., At the point of issue, patients and their families may not always be educated that some inhalers only contain 200 doses and that it is imperative that doses must be closely recorded and monitored. Remove exemption of stalking and flushing out for foxes in the Hunting Act 2004, The Hunting Act 2004 currently exempts the use of up to two dogs to stalk and flush out foxes.
